notes.title: Fix the MultiPlay Lobby error!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]I'm sorry for your inconvenience.[/b][/h2]
We fixed the problem because we identified it as a problem that we couldn't check with each other because the access area was not fixed. Also, I put in a number of convenient functions, and if the error continues after this, please report it.
